name: open-code-review
description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: A tool that automatically reads your team's code changes and leaves smart, specific comments, catching bugs and security holes before a human reviewer even looks.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size software agency who needs consistent code review quality without hiring more senior reviewers.
business_use_cases: A dev shop runs it on every pull request across all client projects so junior devs' code gets senior-level scrutiny before it ships.
A fintech startup uses its security ruleset (SQL injection, XSS checks) to satisfy a compliance audit requirement cheaply.
A code-quality consultancy offers 'automated review setup' as an onboarding service for new clients.

money_ideas.idea: Sell setup and custom ruleset consulting for teams adopting it in regulated industries
Offer a hosted, managed version with dashboards as a subscription add-on for teams that don't want to self-host

steal_this: This weekend, package a pre-configured ruleset for one specific stack (e.g. Django + Postgres) and sell it as a one-click 'security review starter kit' to freelance devs.
